Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: Synastry
Description: A Penumbra animation launcher for organizing, pairing, and synchronizing multi-actor animations.
Changelog: Experimental test partner: make an empty Penumbra collection named Synastry (Collections tab, New). Synastry gives it to your minion only, fills it with the character file's mods without saving them, and cleans up when you release the minion.
